说明: 数据库模式（Text-to-SQL）评测。expect 里的标准答案不手写，评测时用 sql 在数据库上实时算出（执行准确率：Agent 的计算结果里能找到参考答案才算对，相对误差 0.2% 以内；percent=true 时 7.12 和 0.0712 都算对）。report_sql 用参考 SQL 算出名称，要求报告里出现。tables 是回答这道题需要的表，用于 schema linking 专项评测。 退货率按订单计算，和知识库里公司的口径一致（第一轮评测时语义层按明细行算，和知识库冲突，见调优记录）。

cases.question: 各品类的销售额分别是多少？

expect.label: 钓竿销售额
expect.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price*oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE p.category='钓竿'

expect.label: 鱼线销售额
expect.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price*oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE p.category='鱼线'

expect.label: 钓竿退货率（按订单）
expect.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.is_returned=1 THEN oi.order_id END)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE p.category='钓竿'

cases.question: 各店铺分别有多少个订单、销售额是多少？
cases.note: 一个订单有多行明细：和明细 JOIN 后要 COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)

expect.label: 店铺A 订单数
expect.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN shops s USING(shop_id) WHERE s.shop_name='店铺A'

expect.label: 店铺A 销售额
expect.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price*oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN shops s USING(shop_id) WHERE s.shop_name='店铺A'

cases.question: 哪个地区的客单价最高？是多少？

expect.label: 最高客单价
expect.sql: SELECT MAX(v) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price*oi.quantity)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) v FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY o.region)

report_sql: SELECT region FROM (SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.unit_price*oi.quantity)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) v FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY o.region) ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 2025 年哪个月的销售额最高？是多少？

expect.label: 最高月销售额
expect.sql: SELECT MAX(v) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) m, SUM(oi.unit_price*oi.quantity) v FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY m)

cases.question: 各店铺的广告投入产出比（ROAS）是多少？哪个最高？
cases.note: 广告花费按月 × 店铺 × 品类汇总：直接 JOIN 明细会把广告费重复计算（扇出），要先各自汇总

expect.label: 店铺A ROAS
expect.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price*oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.shop_id='S1') / (SELECT SUM(spend) FROM ad_spend WHERE shop_id='S1')

expect.label: 店铺C ROAS
expect.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price*oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.shop_id='S3') / (SELECT SUM(spend) FROM ad_spend WHERE shop_id='S3')

cases.question: 店铺C 在加州卖出的钓竿销售额是多少？
cases.note: 三个取值分别在三张表；“钓竿”在 products 和 ad_spend 里都有

expect.label: 店铺C 加州钓竿销售额
expect.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price*oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) JOIN shops s USING(shop_id) WHERE s.shop_name='店铺C' AND o.region='加州' AND p.category='钓竿'

cases.question: 各品类扣除退货后的净销售额是多少？哪个品类最高？

expect.label: 最高的净销售额
expect.sql: SELECT MAX(v) FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN oi.is_returned=0 THEN oi.unit_price*oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) v FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING(product_id) GROUP BY p.category)

report_sql: SELECT category FROM (SELECT p.category, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.is_returned=0 THEN oi.unit_price*oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) v FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING(product_id) GROUP BY p.category) ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 平均评分最低的品类是哪个？平均几分？

expect.label: 最低平均评分
expect.sql: SELECT MIN(v) FROM (SELECT AVG(oi.rating) v FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING(product_id) GROUP BY p.category)

report_sql: SELECT category FROM (SELECT p.category, AVG(oi.rating) v FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING(product_id) GROUP BY p.category) ORDER BY v LIMIT 1

cases.question: 销量最高的商品是哪个？一共卖了多少件？

expect.label: 最高销量（件）
expect.sql: SELECT MAX(v) FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity) v FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id)

report_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING(product_id) GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 各品类的 ACOS（广告花费占销售额的比例）是多少？
cases.note: ad_spend 按品类名关联 products.category，不是外键

expect.label: 钓竿 ACOS
expect.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(spend) FROM ad_spend WHERE category='钓竿') / (SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price*oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE p.category='钓竿')
